focus.name: interaction-spawn-type46-gate-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the selector-0xAF Type-0x46 interaction gate to a stable creation identity while retaining its historical gate name.

contracts: Selector 0xAF first requires INTERACTION_GATE_GENERIC to be nonzero.
The handler then suppresses creation when GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER equals ASCII '9'.
When both gates permit execution, the handler forward-spawns the established Type-0x46 shared actor template at 0x001B79CC through InteractionSpawn_ForwardSlot.
evidence: Exact handler body and INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE membership
limitations: The name identifies the Type-0x46 creation gate and direct allocator contract, not the user-facing interaction role.
The runtime meaning of the generic gate and selector reachability remain unresolved.
